description: This file implements Whisper-based speech-to-text services supporting both Faster Whisper and MLX Whisper backends, including model selection, language mapping, and transcription handling.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: Enum for selecting Whisper models for Faster Whisper, including multilingual and English-only options.

classes.name: MLXModel
classes.description: Enum for selecting MLX Whisper models optimized for Apple Silicon, including quantized variants.

classes.name: WhisperSTTService
classes.description: Service class for transcribing audio using a locally-downloaded Whisper model with support for multiple languages and models.

classes.name: WhisperSTTServiceMLX
classes.description: Subclass of WhisperSTTService for using MLX Whisper models, optimized for Apple Silicon, with on-demand model loading.

methods.name: language_to_whisper_language
methods.description: Maps pipecat Language enum to Whisper language codes.

methods.name: WhisperSTTService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the Whisper STT service with model, device, language, and other settings.

methods.name: WhisperSTTService._load
methods.description: Loads the Whisper model; for MLX models, this is a no-op as models load on demand.

methods.name: WhisperSTTService._handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles transcription results with tracing; implementation not shown.

methods.name: WhisperSTTService.run_stt
methods.description: Performs speech-to-text transcription on provided audio bytes, yields transcription or error frames.

methods.name: WhisperSTTServiceMLX.__init__
methods.description: Initializes MLX Whisper service with model, language, and other parameters.

methods.name: WhisperSTTServiceMLX._load
methods.description: MLX models load on demand; this method is a no-op.

methods.name: WhisperSTTServiceMLX._handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles transcription results for MLX Whisper; implementation not shown.

methods.name: WhisperSTTServiceMLX.run_stt
methods.description: Performs speech-to-text transcription using MLX Whisper, yields transcription or error frames.
